name: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) Declaration
description: MRP must be clearly declared with Indian Rupee symbol (₹ or Rs.) and explicitly state 'inclusive of all taxes' (or 'incl. of all taxes'). Rounding must follow standard currency denomination.

name: Net Quantity in Standard Metric Units
description: Net quantity must be declared using metric units (g, kg, mL, L, m, cm, or N/units) without misleading non-standard qualifiers like 'Jumbo', 'Family Pack', or 'Approximate'.

name: Unit Sale Price (USP)
description: Unit Sale Price (e.g. ₹/g, ₹/mL, ₹/kg, ₹/piece) is mandatory on packages containing net quantity greater than 100g/100mL or multi-piece retail packs.

name: Month and Year of Manufacture / Packing
description: The month and year of manufacture or pre-packing must be prominently printed on the package (e.g., 'Mfg Date: 03/2026' or 'Packed: Mar 2026').

name: Expiry Date / Best Before Period
statute: Food Safety and Standards (Packaging and Labelling) Regulations
description: Perishable goods, cosmetics, and packaged food must declare an expiry date ('Expiry Date: DD/MM/YYYY') or 'Best Before X months from packaging'.

name: Batch, Lot, or Code Identification
description: A batch number, lot number, or distinctive code identifying the production lot must be legibly printed for traceability.

name: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer Name
description: Name of the manufacturer, packer, or importer must be clearly identified with appropriate prefix ('Manufactured by', 'Packed by', or 'Imported by').

name: Complete Postal Address with PIN Code
description: The complete registered address of the manufacturer or packer must include street name, city/district, state, and 6-digit postal PIN code.

name: Consumer Care Redressal Mechanism
description: Package must designate a consumer care person, official customer care telephone helpline, active email ID, and postal address for grievances.

name: Country of Origin Declaration
description: Every package must prominently declare Country of Origin (e.g. 'Country of Origin: India', 'Made in India', or overseas country).

name: Generic or Common Commodity Name
description: The common or generic name of the commodity must be stated on the principal display panel to inform consumers of the true nature of the contents.

name: Vegetarian / Non-Vegetarian Logo
statute: Food Safety and Standards (Packaging and Labelling) Regulations
description: Packaged food items must display the prescribed green dot inside a green outlined square (Vegetarian) or brown triangle inside a square (Non-Vegetarian).

name: Quantitative List of Ingredients
statute: Food Safety and Standards (Packaging and Labelling) Regulations
description: Ingredients must be listed in descending order of incoming weight (m/m) or volume (v/v) at the time of manufacture.

name: FSSAI Logo and 14-Digit License Number
statute: Food Safety & Standards Authority of India Regulations
description: All food products must carry the official FSSAI logo alongside the 14-digit state or central manufacturing/repacking license number.

name: Principal Display Panel (PDP) & Font Legibility
description: All mandatory declarations must be printed in high-contrast color against background, meeting minimum font height requirements corresponding to net weight.
